title: Warhawk eggplant (Warhawk F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Warhawk eggplant is an F1 hybrid eggplant variety from Allied Botanical. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Warhawk eggplant is an F1 hybrid eggplant variety, also sold or known as Warhawk F1 or Warhawk talong. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical.

heroImage.alt: Rows of young eggplant on furrowed beds in Norzagaray, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Warhawk eggplant is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Warhawk F1 or Warhawk talong, this is the same eggplant. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [eggplant variety finder](/crop-varieties/eggplant), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit eggplant fields most often: [eggplant fruit and shoot borer](/pests/eggplant-fruit-and-shoot-borer), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 50 to 55 days after transplanting (seller sheet).
**Fruit:** Long, heavy cylinders, glossy dark purple with a green calyx, 25 to 28 cm, 120 to 150 g.
Intermediate resistance to bacterial wilt and phytophthora blight (seller sheet).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of three hybrids that farmers in Arayat, Pampanga use, per a published variety trial, in Allied Botanical's current eggplant line. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual eggplant on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Warhawk eggplant

Buyers in each market want their own talong: long and slim and dark purple in most of Luzon, rounder or striped in some towns. Pick a variety with bacterial wilt resistance, and plan for the fruit and shoot borer whatever you plant, because no variety on the market resists it. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Warhawk F1 the same as Warhawk?
items.a: Yes. Warhawk F1 is another name for Warhawk. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Warhawk?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
